sections.content:
Level 2 layout:
- Top band (rows 0-9): black region on the left (columns 0-15) with 4 colored 2x2 blocks: S(1-2,1-2), M(1-2,5-6), p(1-2,9-10), Y(1-2,13-14). The rest of the band is dark gray (c). Yellow 4x4 at (3-6, 30-33).
- Play area (rows 10-62): black, blue ball at (23-31, 29-37), center ~(27,33). 8 S dots: (37,18),(37,41),(40,37),(41,16),(54,49),(55,14),(56,47),(57,16).
- White bar at the bottom (full width, 64).
Interesting point: the S dots form pairs: left pair (37,18),(41,16) and (55,14),(57,16); right pair (37,41),(40,37) and (54,49),(56,47). Hmm, actually 4 pairs:
- (37,18) and (41,16)
- (37,41) and (40,37)
- (55,14) and (57,16)
- (54,49) and (56,47)
Each pair is 2 dots separated by (2,-2) or (3,-4)... let me compute: (37,18)→(41,16): Δ=(4,-2). (37,41)→(40,37): Δ=(3,-4). (55,14)→(57,16): Δ=(2,2). (54,49)→(56,47): Δ=(2,-2).
Hmm, maybe these dots are "waypoints" that the ball must pass through, or maybe the ball has to collect them. The colored blocks in the top-left (S, M, p, Y) might be a legend of the colors used in the game. The yellow 4x4 in the top band might be a level indicator (in level 1 there was a purple 3x3 at the same position).
Wait, in level 1 the top band had a purple 3x3 at (4-6,30-32) — the same color as the moving block. In level 2 the top band has a yellow 4x4 at (3-6,30-33). But there's no yellow object in the play area. Hmm.
Maybe the yellow block in the top band indicates the "target color" of the ball? The ball is blue...
Or maybe the mechanic is: the ball is the player; clicking an S dot moves the ball there (within range); the goal is to visit all the S dots? The S legend block in the top-left might indicate that S dots are the collectible type.
Let me probe: click the S dot closest to the ball. Ball center (27,33). Distances: (37,37)? Wait, node 11 is S at (40,37)? Let me re-list: node 9 S (37,18); node 10 S (37,41); node 11 S (40,37); node 12 S (41,16); node 13 S (54,49); node 14 S (55,14); node 15 S (56,47); node 16 S (57,16).
Distances from (27,33): (40,37): 13+4=17; (37,41): 10+8=18; (37,18): 10+15=25; (41,16): 14+17=31; (54,49): 27+16=43; (56,47): 29+14=43; (55,14): 28+19=47; (57,16): 30+17=47.
In level 1 the range was 12. If it's the same here, none of the dots are within 12! The closest is (40,37) at 17. Hmm. So either the range is different, or the ball can't move directly to the dots.
Maybe the mechanic is different: the ball bounces, or the dots are targets that the ball moves toward when clicked? Or ACTION7 does something (shoot the ball?).
Or maybe the S dots are "stars" and the goal is to move the ball to each dot, with a larger range? Let me probe by clicking (40,37) and see what happens. If nothing moves, try clicking the ball itself, then try ACTION7.
Actually wait — maybe I should reconsider: in level 1, the purple block was the player and the ball was the target. In level 2, maybe the ball is the player and the S dots are the path. Let me probe by clicking (40,37).
